body:
**What you must know:** the orchestrator now has to run `kit.py brief` before it answers you, or the kit refuses its reply. The clerk stops starting new orchestrators. Harmonize still needs the update (I was refused access to that repo).

## The brief
`python3 -I .kit/kit.py brief`: open decision posts (age, default, what each blocks), your comments, Likes and answers of the last 3 days, each train's state from its posts. Board only: a chat decision is written on the board as a comment by the orchestrator. Flags an `_orchestrator` post naming another session.

## The guard
`kit_brief_guard.py` (Claude Code CLI, web, agy): an orchestrator reply to your comment (`board_cli.py reply`, or an ArtifactData comment with `reply_to`) is refused unless a brief ran in that session in the last 15 min.

## Trains and task list
A status 'done' is done (HL1 no longer runs); held and closed show as such on the card and in resume (`[h]`). `kit.py adopt` gives older posts (HL6, VR5, HL5, A3...) their train once, so resume and the task list see them.

## The clerk
Starts a fresh orchestrator only if the named one failed, completed, is archived or unreachable; an idle one is woken. The orchestrator writes its id on every `_orchestrator` it serves.

## Memory (your yes)
Where things stand is the board only. Session start serves `kit.py brief`, not memory Next: lines. Memory keeps lessons, the workflow, preferences and open timers. `kit.py compact` archives old state files, awaits.md and closed issues once; open issues are listed until posted as `kind: issue` posts.
